fields.Name: Tour Workspace Quick Configurator
fields.Title: Workspace Quick Configurator
fields.Description: Interactive onboarding selector rendered inside Guided Tour EmbeddedComponent steps so new users can choose a starting workspace track or mark onboarding configuration complete.
fields.FunctionalRequirements: Displays 3 clickable workspace tracks (Explore Data, Collaborate with Sage, Manage & Build) with keyboard-accessible selection cards, optional custom focus area input, and completion actions that emit 'chooseBranch' (with payload { choiceKey }) and 'completeStep' events through callbacks.OnEvent to drive TourSession branching and step progression.
fields.TechnicalDesign: Stateless-mount React component accepting standard MJ ComponentSpec props (data, step, callbacks). Uses useState hooks directly from the sandbox runtime, design-token CSS variables (--mj-*) with safe fallbacks, accessible role='radiogroup'/aria-checked controls, and calls callbacks.OnEvent('chooseBranch', { choiceKey }) when a user selects and applies a workspace track or callbacks.OnEvent('completeStep', { selectedTrack, completed: true }) on direct completion.

fields.Name: Tour Interactive Readiness Check
fields.Title: Interactive Tour Readiness Check
fields.Description: Interactive pre-publish readiness checklist widget bound via TourStepType.ComponentID for validating anchor hygiene, step count, outcome goals, and accessibility before publishing a tour.
fields.FunctionalRequirements: Presents an interactive author readiness checklist covering semantic anchor selection, concise step count (<= 5 steps), outcome Goal definition, and WCAG 2.2 AA review. Allows authors to inspect dynamic criteria passed via data.checks or check off each item interactively, showing live completion progress and enabling a 'Confirm Readiness & Continue' action that emits callbacks.OnEvent('completeStep', { allReady: true, checkedItems }).
fields.TechnicalDesign: Self-contained React ComponentSpec widget accepting data (checks override, heading), step, and callbacks. Manages per-item completion via useState, renders semantic checkboxes with accessible labels and progress bar using --mj-* CSS custom properties, and triggers callbacks.OnEvent('completeStep', payload) when all readiness checks pass.
